summary:
AstroCare is an AI-powered astronaut health monitoring system developed as a web-based platform to support astronaut health and safety during space missions. It provides a centralized dashboard to record, store, monitor, and review important health parameters such as heart rate, blood pressure, body temperature, glucose levels, and other health indicators. The system helps identify unusual health readings and maintains historical health records for better monitoring and assessment.
AstroCare addresses the challenges of monitoring astronaut health in space by bringing multiple health parameters together in one accessible platform. Its user-friendly dashboard makes health information easier to understand and manage. This project is important because astronauts face unique health challenges during long-duration missions, where continuous health awareness is essential. AstroCare aims to support safer space exploration through technology and provides a foundation for future AI-based health assessment and predictive features.
details:
Project Name: AstroCare – AI-Powered Astronaut Health Monitoring System

AstroCare is a web-based astronaut health monitoring system designed to support the physical and mental well-being of astronauts during space missions. Astronauts face several health challenges in space, including changes in heart rate, blood pressure, body temperature, glucose levels, sleep patterns, and mental health. Monitoring these parameters is essential for maintaining astronaut safety, especially during long-duration missions.

Our project provides a centralized dashboard where health measurements can be entered, stored, monitored, and reviewed. It helps identify unusual health readings through health-status indicators and provides access to historical health records. The system aims to make health information easier to understand and manage.

Benefits and Intended Impact:

AstroCare helps organize multiple health parameters in one platform, supports early identification of unusual readings, maintains historical health records, and improves health-data accessibility. Its intended impact is to contribute to safer astronaut health management and support future human space exploration.

Technologies and Tools Used:

  • Programming Language: Python
  • Backend: Flask
  • Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
  • Database: SQLite
  • Development Environment: Visual Studio Code
  • Additional Libraries: Pandas, NumPy and Scikit-learn, where applicable.

Creativity and Innovation:

The innovative aspect of AstroCare is its integration of multiple astronaut health parameters into a single platform. It features a user-friendly, NASA Mission Control-inspired dashboard that presents health information in an organized and visually understandable manner. It also provides a foundation for future AI-based health assessment and predictive capabilities.

Factors Considered During Development:

Our team considered astronaut safety, multiple health-monitoring parameters, reliable data storage, user-friendly design, accessibility, and the challenges associated with long-duration space missions. We also focused on developing a flexible system that can be enhanced with advanced AI technologies in the future.

Expected Impact:

AstroCare aims to contribute to astronaut well-being by providing an accessible and expandable health-monitoring solution. It demonstrates how software and intelligent technologies can support health awareness, monitoring, and safer space exploration.
